questions.question: How should this fix reach #1131's branch, given this machine's commits are unsigned?

options.label: Side PR, squash-merge (Recommended)
options.description: Commit on a new branch off store-model-axioms and open a PR into it, as with #1136. Your squash-merge makes it a GitHub-signed commit, so #1131 stays all-verified. I resolve the review thread after you merge.

options.label: Push to store-model-axioms
options.description: Commit straight onto #1131's head and resolve the thread now. Faster, but #1131 then carries one unsigned commit again. That is harmless only if #1131 itself is squash-merged, never merged with a merge commit.

questions.question: #1131's PR description still says the spec promotion is open and covers only #1132. Update it too?

options.label: Rewrite to current state (Recommended)
options.description: Summary covers #1132 to #1136 (axioms, decided § 10, spec 051, BK-437 tags, decision log), drops the stale open decision, and lists all five BK-435/BK-437 traces with derived diff figures. Edits the live PR text.

options.label: Leave it
options.description: Only the research doc changes. The description stays stale until you or a later session rewrites it.
